notes.title: HOTFIX released 1.0.3
notes.content:
- [b]Input delay fixed[/b]
- [b]Sprint Speed change[/b]

- Quest items got a visual Indicator

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hotfix 1.0.2
- Less Damage from small Werewolves and other NPCs
To prevent instant deaths from ambush attacks.
- Noise reduction from the Flare
- Graphicshader changed
- Shotsound from Lycans changed

notes.title: Huntfeast is now released
notes.content:
[b]HUNTFEAST RELEASE IN EARLY ACCESS[/b]

The Werewolfhunt can begin! Choose already in between 3 Gamemodes:

[b]Story mode[/b]
Follow the Story and see how it all begins. Lycans and Monsters are in your way to finally reveal the Werewolf's true Form at the end of the Story.

[b]Black and White Werewolfhunt![/b]
Jump directly into the Hunt after the Big Werewolf, find [b]all 4[/b] [b]Feastplaces[/b], and hunt the Werewolf down.
